race.comment: ALL BANGED UP (2) has placed three of five overall including one over this distance range two back. Maps ideally for Cormack from gate three and will be rock-hard fit for this contest. Rates the testing material against this line-up. ROTH AUTHORITY (8) put in a career-best performance when runner-up by the narrowest of margins last time out and may have turned the corner now. Looms as the main danger. POWER CRUISE (13) has hit the top-five in his past five starts and gets the services of Kennedy in the irons. In the mix. OVERLAND (7) has placed two of four over this distance range and Wiggins stays on top. Can feature in the finish. IT'S SHOWTIME (4) rounds out the selections.
